description: Generate a SHA-256 or SHA-512 digest of UTF-8 text in hexadecimal or Base64 form. Use it for checksums, cache keys or comparing content; it is a plain digest, not a keyed HMAC or a password hash. Runs without network access and does not store your input. Input up to 100,000 bytes; larger input is an error. Returns algorithm, encoding, digest and bytes (input length). Defaults: sha256, hex; any other algorithm or encoding is an error.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 0 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

name: hash_generate
